fields.name: retirement_age
fields.label: Retirement age
fields.description: Align with the collective labour agreement/company regulations

fields.name: auto_create_user
fields.label: Create a user account when an employee is created

fields.name: ess_reject_outside_geofence
fields.label: Reject punches outside the location radius
fields.description: Off = accept but flag for HR review

fields.name: ess_default_radius_m
fields.label: Default location radius (m)
fields.description: Used when a Location has no attendance radius

fields.name: ess_max_gps_accuracy_m
fields.label: Max GPS accuracy (m)
fields.description: Worse accuracy is accepted but flagged

fields.name: ess_bind_device
fields.label: One registered phone per employee
fields.description: The first phone that punches is registered on the employee (ESS device id). HR clears it to allow a new phone.

fields.name: ess_require_photo
fields.label: Ask for a selfie on every punch

fields.name: ess_min_punch_interval_minutes
fields.label: Minimum minutes between punches of the same type

fields.name: ess_overnight_window_hours
fields.label: Night shift: check-out within (hours) of check-in
fields.description: A check-out after midnight within this window belongs to the check-in date

fields.name: ess_require_face
fields.label: Require face match on every punch
fields.description: The app compares the face with the employee's verified Face Registration and sends the match score

fields.name: ess_reject_face_mismatch
fields.label: Reject punches below the face score
fields.description: Off = accept but flag for HR review (the day becomes INV until HR decides)

fields.name: attendance_finalize_hours
fields.label: Decide missing clock-in/out after (hours)
fields.description: Hours after the scheduled end before a working day without punches becomes ABS, or a single punch becomes NCIN/NCOUT

fields.name: attendance_window_hours
fields.label: Clock-in accepted from (hours before shift)
fields.description: Earlier clock-ins, clock-ins after the shift end and clock-outs before the shift start are INV

fields.name: attendance_backfill_days
fields.label: Create daily attendance for the last (days)
fields.description: The attendance job creates and finalizes records for this many past days; use the monthly recap's Recalculate for older days

fields.name: attendance_cutoff_start_day
fields.label: Attendance cut-off start day
fields.description: Start day of the monthly attendance recap period (1–31). If greater than the end day (e.g. 21 to 20), it starts in the previous month

fields.name: attendance_cutoff_end_day
fields.label: Attendance cut-off end day
fields.description: End day of the monthly attendance recap period (1–31, clamped to the month's last day)

fields.name: careers_enabled
fields.label: Accept applications from the careers portal
fields.description: Turns on the public API /api/careers/v1/{tenant}. Only Job Postings that are published and open are shown

fields.name: careers_portal_url
fields.label: Careers portal address
fields.description: Public address of the careers site, for example https://karir.acme.co.id. Links in e-mails to applicants point here

fields.name: careers_privacy_notice
fields.label: Privacy notice for applicants
fields.description: Shown before applying; the applicant must agree. The text agreed to is stored on the applicant

fields.name: applicant_retention_months
fields.label: Applicant data retention (months)
fields.description: Rejected or withdrawn applicants older than this are anonymized automatically (UU PDP).

fields.name: allow_manager_talent_access
fields.label: Allow managers to view talent records of direct reports
fields.description: Off (default) = restricted to HR-Talent. On = Managers can also read Talent Review, Succession Plan, and Development Plan for their direct reports.

fields.name: talent_high_perf_threshold
fields.label: Talent Review High performance threshold
fields.description: Appraisal final score >= this value maps to High performance (default 3.75)

fields.name: talent_mod_perf_threshold
fields.label: Talent Review Moderate performance threshold
fields.description: Appraisal final score >= this value maps to Moderate performance (default 2.5)

fields.name: annual_training_budget_per_unit
fields.label: Annual training budget per unit (0 = unlimited)

rules.name: careers_portal_url_required
rules.message: Fill the careers portal address before turning on the careers portal

rules.name: careers_privacy_notice_required
rules.message: Fill the privacy notice before turning on the careers portal
